tools.name: apecheck_report
tools.description: Paid (x402, USDC on Base). Full safety report for a Base ERC-20 token contract: metadata, raw owner address, mint-selector heuristic, approximate recent-activity signal. Call without 'tx' first to receive the exact x402 payment challenge (amount, asset, payTo address, chain); pay that amount in USDC

tools.name: secheaders_report
tools.description: Paid (x402, USDC on Base). Full HTTP security-headers report for a URL: every header checked, raw values, remediation detail. Call without 'tx' first to receive the exact x402 payment challenge; pay, then call again with the transaction hash in 'tx' to receive the full report.

tools.name: llmstxt_check
tools.description: FREE, no payment required. Checks whether a site has a valid llms.txt file (the emerging convention for telling AI crawlers/agents what a site is and how to use it): fetches it, reports status and any errors/warnings.

tools.name: crawlercheck_check
tools.description: FREE, no payment required. Checks a site's robots.txt against a list of known AI crawlers (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, Google-Extended, etc.) and reports which are allowed or blocked.
